name: Cheryce
roleLine: Sustainability news, video & the company map
bestFor: Monthly sustainability or tech news roundups

story: I’m Cheryce — I help you see how sustainability news and real-world examples affect your bills and timing. Start on the **Media wire** for live content counts and headline lanes, then open the desk for news editions, video briefings, and the sustainability map. When a story sparks “what about our site?”, Site Brief helps package cost drivers and upgrade signals before you hand to Andrieus or Artemis.
